A free TradeZella alternative for crypto futures

TradeZella is a capable journal for stock and futures traders, and it costs $35 to $99 a month. If you trade crypto perpetuals, the numbers that decide your month - funding, liquidations, maker versus taker - are the ones a general journal handles least. MarginPad Journal is built around them, connects your exchange read-only, and is free.

When TradeZella is the better choice

If most of your trading is US stocks, options or CME futures through a broker it integrates with, or you want its replay and backtesting tools, TradeZella covers that world and MarginPad Journal does not. If your trading is crypto perpetuals on the exchanges below, a journal that reads funding and liquidations from the exchange will tell you more, and costs nothing.
